message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Below the title, smaller text reads "EDISI 18-24 April 2011". At the top, a small portrait of a man in a black hat and suit is flanked by the words "LIPUTAN KHUSUS" and "WAHID HASYIM". A yellow circle on the left contains the words "BOM DI MASJID KANTOR POLISI". Large red capital letters on the right read "TERGILAS KERETA BEKAS".

A cartoon-style illustration occupies the bottom two-thirds. A white, boxy train engine with rectangular windows is on a railroad track. The track extends toward a man with grey hair, wearing a blue suit, who is bent over and pushing a large red cylindrical roll along the track's path. The red material unrolls beneath him, covering the tracks. The background is a flat, pale landscape with distant hills under a light purple sky. 

Text on the right reads: "Mantan pejabat Kementerian Perhubungan menyeret Hatta Rajasa dalam perkara korupsi pengadaan kereta eks Jepang. Kerabat dekat Hatta terlibat?". At the bottom is a barcode and the phrase "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN".
